勾选后，选 +N 档会同时把场景曝光下调 N EV，即完整的「欠曝 N 档再迫冲:
When on, choosing +N stops also lowers scene exposure by N EV — a full “underexpose N stops, then push”.
Development only recovers part of it (0.2–0.6 EV/stop), so the frame stays darker and contrastier than standard processing.
When off, only the development curve changes and exposure is untouched

青色（C）：左偏青，右偏红: Cyan (C): left toward cyan, right toward red

Brighten after a push with this, not scene exposure — otherwise you cancel the underexposure

把画面最亮像素再抬高 N 档后交给光晕/散射，重建被扫描截断的高光能量。\n保护:
Raises the brightest pixels N stops before halation/scatter, rebuilding highlight energy clipped by scanning.
The protection point sits 4 stops above middle grey: a normally exposed negative never reaches it, so the slider does nothing until the frame is strongly overexposed or +EV compensation is applied
颗粒强度：1.0 为 gold200 标定参考，0 无颗粒，2.0 噪声幅度加倍:

Rate falls with the square of the multiplier, so higher multipliers give finer grain

1.0 is the profile's calibrated geometry; amplitude is set by Grain strength
彩色颗粒混合：1.0 为档案标定（三染料云独立），0 为共用亮度颗粒（类似黑白）:
Colour grain mix: 1.0 is the profile calibration (three independent dye clouds), 0 shares one luminance grain (like B&W).
No effect on black-and-white stocks
模拟欠曝底片被强行扫描提亮时放大的读出噪声。\n0 = 关闭；拉起后暗部出现颗粒:
Simulates the read noise amplified when an underexposed negative is brightened during scanning.
0 = off; once raised, shadows show grain while highlights are barely affected — pair with Black point lift for the lab-scan look.
Only effective in GPU preview and GPU export; CPU export contains no grain.
